definitions.gloss: personal belongings; carry-on items; personal effects
definitions.explanation: Items that a person carries with them, especially when traveling. Commonly seen on signs and in announcements at airports, stations, and public facilities.

examples.japanese: {携帯品|けいたいひん}にご{注意|ちゅうい}ください。
{携帯品|けいたいひん}の{検査|けんさ}にご{協力|きょうりょく}ください。
examples.english: Please cooperate with the inspection of your carry-on items.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}では{携帯品|けいたいひん}から{目|め}を{離|はな}さないようにしてください。
examples.english: At the airport, please do not leave your personal belongings unattended.

notes:
A compound of {携帯|けいたい} (carrying, portable) and {品|ひん} (item, article). This word is commonly seen in formal announcements, signage, and regulations at airports, train stations, and other public facilities.

Note that while {携帯|けいたい} is commonly associated with mobile phones in casual speech, in {携帯品|けいたいひん} it retains its original meaning of "things one carries."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {携帯品|けいたいひん}の{検査|けんさ}: inspection of personal items
- {携帯品|けいたいひん}に{注意|ちゅうい}: watch your belongings
- {携帯品|けいたいひん}{申告|しんこく}: declaration of personal effects (customs)
- {携帯品|けいたいひん}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}み: bringing in personal items

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手荷物|てにもつ}: hand luggage, carry-on baggage — specifically luggage brought aboard transportation
- {所持品|しょじひん}: belongings, possessions on one's person — more formal; used in legal and police contexts
- {身|み}の{回|まわ}り{品|ひん}: personal effects — everyday items one keeps close; slightly more informal
